### Font weight

Measured weight set across both source apps: 300, 400, 450, 500, 600, 700, 800 (docs/context §A5). A per-font-size weight map (Tamagui's `font.weight`, keyed identically to `font.size`) was considered and rejected: there is no functional correlation between size and weight in the source CSS — 11px alone appears at weight 500 (`shell.css:52`), 600 (`detail.css:221`) and 700 (`detail.css:33`) in different selectors, so a size->weight function would invent a correlation the source data does not have. Every per-size-step weight entry in `src/tamagui.config.ts` therefore stays the CSS default, 400. The measured set is instead exposed as named constants — `fontWeights` (`src/tokens/fontWeights.ts`, re-exported from both `src/tamagui.config.ts` and the public entry) — which components import and pass directly, e.g. `fontWeight={fontWeights.bold}`. That keeps every one of the seven weight numbers defined exactly once, in a config-adjacent file, rather than as a raw numeric literal in component source (AC7).
